rationale: Builds on the current reverse-tail recurrence baseline without another broad hyperparameter replay. The main change makes periodic quant-aware roundtrips projection-first: tail projection weights see the full blend early, while non-projection attention and other tensors are pulled toward their final int8 roundtrip more conservatively. That keeps the export-surviving endgame pressure on the recurrent tail where local results have been strongest, while reducing destabilizing late-stage perturbations to the rest of the model. I also fixed a masked chunked-loss accumulation bug so any chunked validation path remains correct instead of silently using only the last chunk.
title: Selective Quant-Aware Tail Mixing
